curve: published P-256, actual prime field and prime-order curve
scope: implementation correctness and exact mathematical screening; no EXP, performance experiment, attack or status transition

derived_facts.assumptions: Monic separable F of degree S>=3; actual Dickson input has odd characteristic, S=2^k, c!=+-2. Fully split in Fp additionally checked for tested finite domains.
derived_facts.distinct_locus: Remainder coefficients of F modulo h vanish; finite geometrically reduced with binomial(S,3) points.
derived_facts.jacobian: det d(R0,R1,R2)/d(s1,s2,s3) = Res(h,F/h), nonzero at every separable divisor.
derived_facts.two_equal_locus: F(x)=0 and divided difference (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y)=0; finite reduced, S(S-1) points, diagonal excluded.
derived_facts.joining_s4: Each joint ideal remains reduced; signed curve lifts and point sums still checked.
derived_facts.short_circuit: Repeated squaring modulo h needs O(k) arithmetic gates; expanded coefficient degree S-2 for S>=4.

checks.nonseparable_hypothesis_control: D8-2, h=t^3-4t: remainder zero and Jacobian zero as expected

limitations: The fixed k3 completion and smaller scheme length do not establish a speed advantage or scaling bound.
The validation package enumerates finite-domain references for completeness; that work is not a proposed cheap generic certificate.
Distinct k4 solving remains unknown despite complete repeated strata for its fixed positive target.
Deep witnesses certify divisibility and nonzero Jacobian only; no complete high-depth relation solving.
No target-success distribution, relation rank, logarithm labels, linear algebra, final target attachment or complete ECDLP cost.
Sparse replay is a separate implementation in the same session, not independent review or formal verification.
next_decisive_step: Certified incremental elimination/root extraction on the unexpanded multiplication-gate remainder circuit, replaying fixed k3 and k4 positive/empty controls.
